name: default
description: The dependency loop's shared backbone: OSV, KEV and EPSS Lines and Mandates, the attention and OSV unkeyed Lines, and the security.start (fans out to every SBOM import Line) and security.maintain Runbooks.

expires.description: How long each Mandate stays valid from submission: hours, days, weeks or years (36h, 90d, 12w, 1y).

min_epss.description: EPSS score (0 to 1) at or above which an unjudged pair goes to the inbox (KEV-listed and unscored pairs always do).

name: sarif
description: One scanner's SARIF intake: the import Line, its Mandates, and the attention Line with its landing Trigger. Adopt again under another name per scanner.

expires.description: How long each Mandate stays valid from submission: hours, days, weeks or years (36h, 90d, 12w, 1y).

name.description: Short identifier for this input: the Line suffix and logical source suffix; unique per input of this kind.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the scanner's SARIF 2.1.0 file.

repo.description: The scanned repository as host/owner/repo, lowercase; a SARIF run naming another repository writes nothing.

name: sbom
description: One SBOM import Line (CycloneDX or SPDX 2.2/2.3 JSON) and its Mandates. Adopt again under another name per SBOM; security.start runs them all.

expires.description: How long each Mandate stays valid from submission: hours, days, weeks or years (36h, 90d, 12w, 1y).

name.description: Short identifier for this input: the Line suffix and logical source suffix; unique per input of this kind.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the SBOM JSON file.

name: schedule
description: The daily Trigger security.maintain-daily, which runs security.maintain. Skip it when CI runs the Runbooks.

cron.description: Five-field cron expression, read in UTC.
